_network_type: Backend timing benchmark: 1 LSTM-AE run + 1 SNN-AE dense run, both with direct encoding, fixed (V_th, alpha)
_architecture_summary: Inside one run, the harness trains BOTH the LSTM-AE (matching article-lstm-ae) and the SNN-AE dense (matching article-snn-dense). Architecture and loss come from the (single) flat `model` block: LSTM uses lstm:64+linear:64:leaky+linear:32:tanh and SNN ignores the LSTM-specific entries. Purpose is wall-clock timing only.
_loss_function: MSE for both LSTM and SNN paths (Trainer is hardcoded to MSE; SNN spike-time/spike-count losses are NOT wired in).
_preprocessing: Window 256 samples (32 ms @ 8 kHz). Direct encoding only. SNN dense pre-process. V_th=1.0, alpha=0.9 fixed.
_dataset_config: 50 train, 20 val (FSDD pool, shuffled split). 5 epochs max, early stop patience 5, lr 0.001, batch size 1.
_expected_outputs: results/guayaquil/article_backend_bench_*.csv; .../data/article_backend_bench_*.dat. Run twice (max-performance and max-performance-opencl) and merge with scripts/merge_backend_dat.py.
_comment: Backend timing only. 2 runs per backend, ~5 min each.
